alerts.text: Fable 5: permanent on Max, credits on Pro
alerts.dashboardText: Starting July 20, Claude Fable 5 is a permanent feature on Max and Team Premium plans at 50% of your weekly limits. Pro and Team Standard users move to usage credits — priced at $10/M input and $50/M output tokens — and get a one-time $100 credit to get started. Tap for details.
